headline: Oblivion 1.0 — built on LeviLauncher and LeviDroid-Modder
summary: A new look and a new community layer: Dungeons-style start screen, Skin Changer, Cosmetics, claim codes, OblivionDLC themes and 20 languages.

items.text: Dungeons-style start screen with your gamertag and the skin you are wearing. START GAME uses the normal launch path.
Skin Changer: pick a PNG skin and install it as a skin pack for the selected Minecraft version.
Oblivion Cosmetics: masks, crowns, coats and capes, unlocked by Discord role, Oblivion+ membership or claim codes.
Link Discord to get your Oblivion role (Oblivion, Admin, Staff, Creator, Partner, Oblivion+, Member, New Commer).
Claim codes for events, giveaways and mods. Each code works once; protected files stay encrypted inside Oblivion.
OblivionDLC: install custom UI themes made by the developer.
First-run wizard: language, rules, license, Oblivion Modder, community, Microsoft and Discord (all skippable).
20 languages and a loading screen with a custom video or animated background.
LeviMC mods are now OblivionMod and the launcher news is now OblivionNews.
